criteria.requirement: Define schema and identity policy before import, explicitly validate unknown/required fields, prepare reusable bounded batches, and keep all data writes in a real transaction with errors crossing the rollback boundary. Consider large-file transaction/staging costs and restart/idempotency. Do not treat ensure=False, per-chunk auto-commit or SQLite DDL behavior as a general all-or-nothing guarantee.
Use the actual supplied evidence and pinned source, respect authorization, and distinguish observed behavior, existing guarantees and proposals.

comparison: Accept equivalent correct reasoning and implementations; do not match wording or a reference answer.
